notes.title: Important announcement regarding the full version! 🔜
notes.notes:
The full version of the game is just a few weeks away, so we'd like to address some feedback and share some updates. There have been questions about the sound in the animated scenes - some players find it a bit repetitive. The solution to this issue involves increasing the game's size, and we're not sure if everyone would appreciate that. However, many players would be willing to sacrifice a few gigabytes of space for improved sound. Therefore, we are currently conducting a poll on this matter in our [url=https://discord.gg/xetVqPwuvC]Discord server[/url] - feel free to join and share your opinion! Additionally, we will soon be posting some content from the full version there, so be sure to check it out if you're interested. Following this, we will be hosting a quiz on the characters and story of the prologue - winners will receive free keys to the full version!

We look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Bug fixes and Chinese localisation
notes.notes:
Hi gamers! 🎮

In our latest version of the game on Steam, we've fixed small bugs and improved Chinese localization. Just better gameplay! Play and enjoy! 👾🚀

notes.title: Sex of Thrones 👑 Prologue is finally out - the first chapter of a great journey
notes.notes:
Immerse yourselves in the world of medieval adult fantasy - you'll find yourself in the midst of intrigues regarding the throne, observe strong family tensions, meet some distinctive characters, and see really exhilarating 18+ content with beautiful girls.
After the demo, we took some time to refine and polish everything we could about the game - story, graphics, sound-design and a ton of minor things. The full game releases in just a month, and we've prepared a free prologue, so everyone can check out the vibes, scenes and a bit of story before jumping into the full experience. Feel free to share whatever you think about the game - we'll see and read every opinion, and we're open to any feedback.


[b]Also, don't forget about other great news - alongside with this we're opening up the doors of our discord server - feel free to join the community! [url=https://discord.gg/qaDP7h3x]Join our server in discord[/url][/b]


We're eagerly looking forward to seeing what your thoughts on the prologue are!

notes.title: Sex of Thrones 👑 Prologue is just a few weeks away!
notes.notes:
We're getting a free prologue ready! It will be out on April 26, and it's a great opportunity to get to know what kind of adventure awaits you at the end of May, when we'll release the full version. 
A dark and medieval atmosphere, an intriguing story about 2 daughters of a deposed king striving for the throne, the ability to choose your own way of progressing through the story, a ton of marvelously crafted adult scenes and a lot more will be waiting for you to discover - we're finally ready to introduce you to our game and the surprising journey it's about to take you on.

Thanks to our wonderful community, we gathered a lot of helpful feedback during the demo and worked on improving the entirety of the game - we hope you'll enjoy what we've got for you. Stick to our news for further announcements, there's a lot of them coming soon - consider subscribing to us if you haven't done it yet.

Feel free to share your thoughts or suggestions, and thanks for being here - our players are the only reason we're able and want to
do what we're doing! 💕
